defect: a register update request crosses safely but its source data is not held until the destination samples it
rationale: value_a is not captured or held in clk_a when update_a launches req_a, so the destination can observe a different value when the synchronized request arrives.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: value_a is captured in clk_b a few cycles after the toggle request but nothing holds it stable, and no acknowledgement returns to the source, so it can change before capture.

provenance.adaptation: Kept the source update request, destination request synchronization, data transfer, and acknowledgement context, reduced the register arbitration and bus interfaces, and exposed a self-contained top module.

mutation.description: Captured value_a directly at the destination request event without a source-domain data holding register.
